purpose: Report-only automatic authenticated post-merge main comparisons; explicit PR and acceptance profiles remain unchanged.

inference.implementation: tools/uarch_lab.py compare at one predeclared trusted-main source identity
inference.selection: Exactly one candidate frozen after exploratory pilot and before any confirmatory outcome
claim_family: A/B near-boundary detection probability >=0.90 in family 1
A/B near-boundary detection probability >=0.90 in family 2
inference.assumption: Independent trial classifications conditional on the declared frozen binaries, workload, host and blocked schedule; unresolved serial dependence prevents probability qualification

exploratory.selection: Prefer 40 pairs only if every complete pilot series has a wall-ratio 95% interval half-width <=1 percentage point and required order/drift checks actually evaluated without flags; otherwise consider 80 pairs by the same rule. Failure of both means no confirmatory candidate. Before confirmation, reject the selected candidate unless 158 times the maximum observed complete candidate pilot series occupancy plus nine times the maximum observed comparator occupancy, all declared packet setup/corpus costs and a 10% reserve fit the fixed 12-hour confirmatory physical budget. The 80-pair candidate may be infeasible and must then be rejected without confirmatory work.
exploratory.prohibited: No retrospective prefix serves as confirmatory evidence. Pilot outcomes cannot be pooled with confirmation. Pilot selection is frozen in a later identity-only record before confirmation.

confirmatory.success: All 80 A/A trials produce no faster/slower verdict beyond the unchanged 0.5% floor; all 39 trials in each A/B family detect the independently established intended >=2% regression. Invalid/incomplete/cancelled attempts count against completion and cannot be replaced; any failure prevents this protocol from qualifying a profile.
confirmatory.bound_math: At per-claim alpha=0.05/3, 1-alpha^(1/80)=0.04990 is the upper bound after zero A/A errors, and alpha^(1/39)=0.90032 is the lower detection bound after 39 successes, conditional on trial independence. Comparator significance is not ground truth.
confirmatory.order: An exact schedule ledger is committed before confirmation. At most four short trials per packet; packet families rotate A/A, A/B1, A/B2 across the fixed ledger, and comparator first/last position balances across scheduled comparator packets. Each series uses a fresh directory, warmups and per-run fresh executable copies. Packet repetition alone is not evidence of temporal independence; unresolved dependence invalidates probability qualification.
confirmatory.identity_freeze: Record exact baseline/head and immutable A/A/AB binaries, output digests, separate independent calibration evidence for both near-boundary real compiler changes, source closure/toolchain/host/harness and preparation protocol; no results until freeze commit exists.
confirmatory.known_effect: Two representative compiler changes in distinct pipeline regions with independently established direction and effect uncertainty reaching the declared 2% boundary. A significant v1 run alone or an uncalibrated injected delay cannot establish ground truth. If ground truth cannot be established, retain exploratory evidence and do not claim detection qualification.

coverage.corpus: throughput-corpus-v2 complete default CI corpus, six workloads x FAST/QUALITY, two rounds,20 pairs/round,2 warmups; retain full corpus evidence for every frozen compiler identity and preparation protocol
coverage.self_host: Frozen base unity src/buster/apps/ide/ide.c with historical explicit flags and generated closure
coverage.explicit_acceptance: compiler-compare-v1, throughput-corpus-v2, scaling-v1, clang-analyze-full-v1 and issue-specific acceptance stay unchanged

budgets.completion: Any exhausted budget or unfinished packet is incomplete; preserve all attempted raw evidence and no selected profile activation A single packet helper does not enforce the campaign-wide ledger; qualification remains disabled until the trusted admission/ledger consumer independently bounds every attempt, requested packet/trial identity and cumulative physical occupancy.

required: all raw paired samples and compare.json/summary.json
actual profile fields bound to raw config and exact binary hashes
per-series complete pairs and achieved wall-ratio uncertainty
per-leg measurement, corpus, build and preparation wall time
packet physical occupancy and separate observed queue delay
all failure/cancellation/timeout/invalid evidence and chronological attempted ledger
independence/order/drift diagnostics with checked state, not false default flags
evidence.unknown: Missing uncertainty/completion/occupancy/queue delay is unavailable; not zero, equivalence or performance pass

rollout.activation: Separate reviewed change only after complete real Ryzen 7 9700X evidence qualifies one fixed-pair profile; authenticated automatic post-merge main route only
rollout.rollback: Restore compiler-compare-v1 routing; historical receipts retain original interpretation
rollout.queue_observation: Prespecified seven calendar days before and seven calendar days after activation, all admitted main demand including superseded/coalesced/unmeasured ranges, occupancy and queue timestamps; no queue reduction claim from service-time alone
